items.title: 6.2 Tangent and Normal to a Curve (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 173: 6.2 definitions of tangent, point of contact and normal with Figure 6.7 (text before 6.2.1)

blocks.text: Is sabaq se hum ek naya hissa shuru kar rahe hain: kisi curve ko chhoone wali line (tangent) aur us par perpendicular line (normal). Pichle hisse (6.1) mein aap ne circle ki equations banana seekha. Ab sawal yeh hai ke circle ke kisi point par jo line use sirf chhoo kar guzarti hai, us ki equation kya hogi? Pehle definition ko achhi tarah samajh lete hain, phir agle sabaqon (6.2.1 se 6.2.8) mein yahi idea circle par lagayenge.

Kitab ki definition: agar koi line kisi curve ko bilkul ek point par chhooti hai to use curve ka tangent kehte hain, aur us point ko point of contact (chhoone ka point) kehte hain. Figure 6.7 mein \(\overleftrightarrow{LM}\) curve ko point \(P\) par chhoo rahi hai, is liye yeh \(P\) par tangent hai.

blocks.alt: A curve rising from left to right drawn on X and Y axes with origin O. At a point P on the curve, the line LM touches the curve: this is the tangent. The line PQ through P is perpendicular to LM, with a right angle marked 90 degrees at P: this is the normal.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.7: Tangent LM and normal PQ to a curve at the point P (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Ab doosri definition: tangent ke point of contact par jo line tangent par perpendicular (90 degree par) ho, use us point par curve ka normal kehte hain. Figure 6.7 mein \(\overleftrightarrow{PQ} \perp \overleftrightarrow{LM}\) point \(P\) par hai, is liye \(\overleftrightarrow{PQ}\) point \(P\) par curve ka normal hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ek misaal se samajhiye: mez par ek gol plate rakhi hai aur aap us ke kinare se ek scale (ruler) laga dete hain. Scale plate ko sirf ek jagah chhoota hai. Yeh scale tangent hai, aur jahan woh chhoo raha hai woh point of contact hai.
Ab usi point par ek doosra scale is tarah rakhiye ke pehle scale ke saath bilkul seedha kona (right angle) banaye. Yeh doosra scale normal hai.
Dhyan dein: "sirf ek point par chhoona" wala tasavvur circle aur baqi conics ke liye bilkul theek hai. Aam curve ke liye asal baat yeh hai ke point \(P\) ke qareeb tangent ki direction curve ki direction jaisi hoti hai, yani tangent ka slope wahi hai jo curve ka slope \(P\) par hai.
Slopes of the tangent and the normal

Yeh hissa hamari taraf se izafa hai (kitab yeh baatein 6.2.1 se 6.2.3 mein istemal karti hai). Ab sab se zaroori sawal: tangent ki equation likhne ke liye humein kya chahiye? Point-slope form yaad kijiye: ek point aur ek slope ho to line ki equation foran ban jati hai. Point to humare paas hai, \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\). Slope kahan se aaye? Derivative se! Kisi point par curve ka slope us point par \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ki value hoti hai:
\[m_{T} = \left(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\right)_{(x_{1},\, y_{1})}\]
Normal tangent par perpendicular hai. Do perpendicular lines (jo vertical na hon) ke slopes ka hasil-e-zarb (product) \(-1\) hota hai. Is liye jab \(m_{T} \ne 0\) ho:
\[m_{N} = -\dfrac{1}{m_{T}}\]
Yani normal ka slope tangent ke slope ka ulta (reciprocal) aur sign badla hua hota hai. Ab point-slope form se dono lines:
\[\text{Tangent: } y - y_{1} = m_{T}(x - x_{1})\]
\[\text{Normal: } y - y_{1} = m_{N}(x - x_{1})\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Do khaas cases zehan mein rakhiye:
Agar \(m_{T} = 0\) ho to tangent horizontal (leti hui) line hai, \(y = y_{1}\), aur normal vertical (khari) line hai, \(x = x_{1}\). Yahan formula \(-\frac{1}{m_{T}}\) kaam nahin karta kyun ke zero se taqseem nahin ho sakti; seedha shakal dekh kar likhiye.
Agar tangent khud vertical ho, \(x = x_{1}\), to normal horizontal hoga, \(y = y_{1}\).
Circle ke liye ek bohat kaam ki baat: circle ka tangent point of contact par radius ke perpendicular hota hai. Is ka matlab hai ke circle ke kisi bhi point par normal hamesha centre se guzarta hai. Yeh baat aage baar baar kaam aayegi, khaas taur par 6.2.3 aur 6.2.7 mein.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahin, samajhne ke liye hum ne di hai. Curve \(y = x^{2}\) par point \((1, 1)\) lijiye.
Pehla qadam, slope nikaliye:
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 2x, \quad m_{T} = 2(1) = 2\]
Doosra qadam, tangent: \(y - 1 = 2(x - 1)\), yani \(2x - y - 1 = 0\).
Teesra qadam, normal ka slope ulta aur sign badla hua:
\[m_{N} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Normal: \(y - 1 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 1)\); dono taraf 2 se zarb dein to \(2y - 2 = -x + 1\), yani \(x + 2y - 3 = 0\).
Tasdeeq: \((1, 1)\) dono equations mein rakhiye, dono zero deti hain. Aur slopes ka product \(2 \times \left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = -1\), yani lines waqai perpendicular hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. Agar kisi point par tangent ka slope 3 ho to normal ka slope kya hoga? (Jawab: \(-\frac{1}{3}\))
2. Circle ke centre se kisi point tak radius kheenchiye. Us point par normal aur radius mein kya rishta hai? (Jawab: normal usi radius wali line par hai, kyun ke tangent radius par perpendicular hai.)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Aage 6.2 mein kya aa raha hai (sab circle ke liye):
6.2.1 se 6.2.3: circle ke kisi point par tangent aur normal ki equations, aur tangent likhne ka ek shortcut rule.
6.2.4: koi point circle ke bahar hai, circle par hai ya andar?
6.2.5: line circle ko kahan kaatti hai, aur kab woh sirf chhoo kar tangent banti hai?
6.2.6 se 6.2.8: bahar ke kisi point se circle par tangents, aur us tangent ki lambai (length).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Tangent: woh line jo curve ko point of contact \(P\) par chhooti hai; us ka slope \(P\) par \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ki value hai.
2. Normal: \(P\) se guzarne wali woh line jo tangent par perpendicular ho; \(m_{N} = -\frac{1}{m_{T}}\) (jab \(m_{T} \ne 0\)).
3. Dono lines ek hi point \(P\) se guzarti hain, is liye dono ke liye point-slope form istemal hota hai.
4. Circle par normal hamesha centre se guzarta hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Normal ka slope \(\frac{1}{m_{T}}\) ya \(-m_{T}\) likh dena. Sahi: ulta bhi karna hai aur sign bhi badalna hai, \(-\frac{1}{m_{T}}\).
2. \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikal kar us mein point \(P\) ke coordinates rakhna bhool jana; slope ek number hona chahiye, formula nahin.
3. Horizontal ya vertical case mein formula zabardasti lagana. Jab \(m_{T} = 0\) ho to normal seedha \(x = x_{1}\) hai.
